description: The report-group VARYING clause (§2023:13.18.64) — an independent temporary integer counter per repetition of a repeating report entry: first occurrence ← arithmetic-expression-1 (default 1, GR3a), subsequent occurrences += arithmetic-expression-2 (default 1, GR3b); each value persists through its occurrence (GR4 — usable as a SOURCE item). LIVE (P10 Step 13) on the multiple-COLUMN repetition vehicle (SR1); the OCCURS / multiple-LINE vehicles stage 0899 with the report-group OCCURS family. 2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 report group description entry (§1985:XIII.3.9.2) offers LINE, NEXT GROUP, TYPE, USAGE, PICTURE, SIGN, JUSTIFIED, BLANK WHEN ZERO, '[COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-3]', SOURCE / VALUE / SUM and GROUP INDICATE, no VARYING clause; the 2002 text has it: 'The entry containing the VARYING clause shall also contain an OCCURS clause or, if the VARYING clause appears in a report group description entry, a multiple LINE or multiple COLUMN clause' (§2002:13.16.62.2 SR1) and 'For the first occurrence, the value of arithmetic-expression-1 is moved to data-name-1. If the FROM phrase is absent, 1 is moved to data-name-1' (§2002:13.16.62.3 GR3a); §2002:F.2 records it, item 146 'VARYING clause. A VARYING clause is provided in the validate and report writer facilities to be used in conjunction with an OCCURS clause' and item 115 'VARYING clause may be used with an OCCURS clause or a multiple LINE or multiple COLUMN clause'. 2014 keeps it (§2014:13.18.64.3 GR3a), and VCR row 101's 2002→2014 TERMINATE-with-VARYING flagging delta presupposes the 2002 clause.
vcr: 2002 RW addition (§2002:F.2 items 115 and 146; VCR row 101 presupposes it at 2002)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRVY1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrvy1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE PLUS 1.
      05 COLUMNS ARE 1 5 9 PIC Z9 SOURCE IS R-V VARYING R-V FROM 1 BY 2.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
